valuation.method: Forward TNAV per ADR x P/TBV (12-month horizon). Converted from BARC ordinary shares using 1 BCS ADR = 4 ordinary shares and GBP/USD = 1.322 as of 2026-11-13.

bear.driver: 10.0% sustainable RoTE amid UK macro/credit headwinds

base.driver: 12.5% sustainable RoTE (in line with >12% FY2026 guidance) and ongoing buybacks

bull.driver: 14.0% sustainable RoTE (matching 13.8% YTD Q3 2026 pace) with strong IB and UK NII

valuation.implied_by_close: At base forward TNAV of $24.06 (£18.20/ADR at 1.322 GBP/USD), the $22.87 close implies 0.95x P/TBV; the Street consensus target (~$29.00) implies 1.21x P/TBV.
valuation.sensitivity: Each 0.10x turn of P/TBV on base forward TNAV ($24.06/ADR) moves the base target by $2.41 (+10.5 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Group Return on Tangible Equity (RoTE) vs. >12% target and CET1 capital distribution capacity
valuation.next_disclosure: FY2026 Full Year Results on February 9, 2027

analyst_notes: Following Q3 2026 results on October 22, 2026 (RoTE 11.7% in Q3, 13.8% YTD; TNAV 410p; £500m buyback), Street sentiment remains broadly constructive with Buy/Outperform ratings from Goldman Sachs (700p / $37.02), UBS (590p / $31.20), Jefferies (590p / $31.20), and RBC Capital (525p / $27.76), while Morgan Stanley holds an Equal Weight (580p / $30.67) stance. Most UK-listed BARC targets imply ~1.2x+ P/TBV on forward TNAV, sitting above our 1.10x base case ($26.47) due to higher assumed sustainable RoTE or lower cost of equity.
